subject: Service notice: rw-alpha-3 elevated 5xx/timeouts — mitigation & postmortem plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@fastbank.com>, support@fastbank.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Service notice: rw-alpha-3 elevated 5xx/timeouts — mitigation & postmortem plan

Hi Elena / FastBank team,

We’re reaching out because we observed a spike in 5xx errors and request timeouts affecting the rw-alpha-3 model in your inference routing between 08:48–09:06 PDT this morning. Impact: approximately 4% of requests routed to rw-alpha-3 returned 5xx or timed out; customers with higher seq-lengths or long-context chains saw the largest hit.

What we did (immediate mitigation):
- Rolled back a recent kernel/quantization runtime change for the rw-alpha-3 variant at 08:58 PDT.
- Temporarily routed your requests to rw-alpha-2 (compatible variant) for safety while we investigated.
- Increased alerting sensitivity and added an automated fallback to alpha-2 for any recurrence.

Current status: routing is back to normal for your traffic (we are keeping alpha-2 as fallback for 72 hours while we validate). We’ve attached a bundle of logs and a short incident timeline for your review.

Next steps / postmortem plan:
- Our engineering team will complete a targeted postmortem and share a concise root-cause summary by EOD tomorrow (Mar 13).
- We will coordinate a short working session if you want deeper telemetry or to review impact on your SLA/ingestion patterns.

We’re very sorry for the disruption — I’ll loop in our postmortem note and the remediation timeline as soon as it’s ready. If you noticed any specific requests that failed that you want us to prioritize, please send timestamps/request IDs and we’ll pull full traces.

Attachments: rw-alpha3-incident-logs-20260312.zip (logs), incident-snapshot.txt (attached)

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

—Elena

Initial notes from infra: failure surface looks like intermittent kernel-level OOMs under grouped-attention path on the quantized execution for long sequence requests.

Immediate todo:

- Evelyn: validate rollback artifacts and confirm whether the recent quantization tweak (release 2026-03-11) changed memory allocation behavior under certain batch shapes.

Please keep text short — we’ll publish a customer-facing summary and the internal RCA separately.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@fastbank.com>, markus.klein@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Postmortem: rw-alpha-3 5xx/timeouts on 2026-03-12 — root cause & remediation

Hi Elena / FastBank team,

Apologies again for yesterday’s disruption. Below is a concise postmortem and the actions we’ve completed. We’ll keep this short and can expand on any section you want to discuss.

Summary
- Incident window: 2026-03-12 08:48–09:06 PDT
- Impact: ~4% of requests to rw-alpha-3 returned 5xx/timeouts; observed primarily for sequences > 2048 tokens and batched requests with highly variable sequence lengths. FastBank saw two failed request IDs you reported (fb-20260312-88a, fb-20260312-91b) — we’ve attached full traces.
- Root cause: a regression introduced in the 2026-03-11 quantization/runtime tweak caused non-deterministic memory growth in the grouped-attention kernel for a small set of batch shapes, triggering transient OOMs and hard 5xx responses. The condition was rare in unit tests but appeared under production traffic distributions (long tails of sequence length).

Remediation (completed)
- Rolled back the 2026-03-11 runtime change at 08:58 PDT — immediate reduction in 5xx rate.
- Activated automatic fallback routing to rw-alpha-2 for the next 72 hours and added an alerting rule to catch similar memory-growth signals earlier.
- Replayed affected traces in a staging environment to validate roll-forward fixes.

Remediation (planned / in progress)
- Engineering will ship a targeted kernel patch with deterministic memory accounting by 2026-03-18; Q/A on representative long-tail batches included.
- Add stress tests to the CI that include heavy variability in sequence lengths and batched scenarios.

Customer impact & compensation
- We understand FastBank experienced failed requests that impacted retries. We’ll credit the FastBank account for affected request units for the incident window (proposal: 5% of March usage). We’ll follow up with an official credit proposal via your account rep.

What we’re delivering to you now
- Attached: full traces for fb-20260312-88a and fb-20260312-91b, incident logs (rw-alpha3-incident-logs-20260312.zip) and a short postmortem draft (alpha3-postmortem-draft.pdf).
- Links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ExamplePostmortemLink, JIRA-SUP-1729 for internal tracking.

If you’d like a 30-minute sync to walk through the traces and the remediation timeline, we can schedule one this week. Thank you for the quick heads-up and patience while we investigated.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
